messages:
maria-support: FYI customer hitting function-call failures when invoking our tool endpoint via hosted API. 400 from validator: 'instance has additional properties'. Payload + error below. reported by acct-id=cli-corp-12, request_id=req_0a1b2c3d

deploy-bot: log snippet attached: https://logs.internal/r/req_0a1b2c3d - returned 400 schema_validation_error on /v1/tool/invoke :exclamation:

maria-support: payload example:
```json
POST /v1/tool/invoke
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "tool": "calculator.sum",
  "args": {"a": 3, "b": 5},
  "metadata": "customer-session-42",
  "extra": "unexpected"
}
```

maria-support: error body:
```json
{
  "error": "schema_validation_error",
  "details": [
    {"path": "", "message": "additionalProperties \"extra\" is not allowed"},
    {"path": "/args/a", "message": "expected number but got string"}
  ]
}
```

alex-platform: thanks. quick questions: which SDK/version did they use and do they send requests through SDK or raw curl? can someone repro locally?

maria-support: they used js-sdk@1.4.1 via node, streaming disabled. I repro'd with curl too (see above) and got same 400.

dinesh-eng: looks like two separate failures: 1) additionalProperties for top-level field "extra" and 2) type mismatch inside args (a as string vs number). our tool schema forbids additionalProperties (strict schema) so extra props will error. Do we intentionally enforce strict on hosted?

alex-platform: hosted validator uses schema with additionalProperties=false for tool inputs to avoid silent typos. SDKs typically omit arbitrary fields, but older SDK v1.4.1 accidentally serialized some metadata as top-level when using legacy opts. 1.4.2 fixes this.

maria-support: customer said they upgraded from 1.4.0 -> 1.4.1 recently. they refused to share code but allowed us to repro with their sample.

dinesh-eng: repro steps I used:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tool/invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"calculator.sum","args":{"a":"3","b":5},"extra":"oops"}'
```
Response: same schema error.

dinesh-eng: short-term mitigation: 1) advise customer to upgrade to js-sdk@1.4.2 (contains serializer fix) OR 2) remove stray top-level keys and ensure numeric args. I'll prepare fix on our side to be more tolerant for hosted (log a warning instead of 400) but keep strict mode for Dedicated/Private per contract.

eva-sre: if we relax hosted validation, need to add monitoring for fuzzy-input regressions. add metric schema_validation_failures.toolcall and alert if increase > 3x baseline.

qa-ana: i'll add regression tests for: additionalProperties present, number-vs-string coercion, and sdk-serialization cases. will add tests to the toolcall harness.

maria-support: can we get ETA for hosted fix? customer is blocked in prod.

dinesh-eng: opening INC-2026-78 for hosted toolcall validator. patch branch with change to return 422 + warning log rather than hard 400 in ~1h. will canary on us-east-1 and then roll. I'll post updates here.

maria-support: thx. I told customer we'll follow up in ~2 hours and gave them temporary workaround (explicitly cast numbers and drop extra props). they asked for a timeline for full fix.

alex-platform: noted. also leaving a follow-up task to update SDK changelog and add a breaking-change note for legacy behavior.

dinesh-eng: pushing patch now. will ping when canary is live.

maria-support: :thumbsup: please include request_id=req_0a1b2c3d in the incident so I can reference in support ticket.
